raw_glosses: (computing) A short sequence of bits (binary digits) that can be operated on as a unit by a computer; the smallest usable machine word.
glosses: A short sequence of bits (binary digits) that can be operated on as a unit by a computer; the smallest usable machine word.

examples.text: The word “hello” fits into five bytes of ASCII code.

If you look at the photograph of the interior of the Spectrum[…], you will see that there is one ROM chip, and 16 smaller RAM chips. These chips give the Spectrum its memory. The memory consists of 65536 storage units that each contain one byte (a number from 0 to 255).
